# Pact

> Pact is a Slack bot that turns casual promises into tracked commitments between teammates. Both sides see it, both get reminded, nothing gets dropped.

## What Pact Does

Pact creates bilateral accountability inside Slack. When you say "I'll get that to you by Friday," Pact makes it a real commitment — visible to both parties, with automatic reminders, and a clear resolution when it's done.

The core insight: solo commitments fail because no one is watching. Pact makes someone watching the default.

## How It Works

1. `/pact @teammate` — Create a commitment with a due date and description. Pact DMs both parties to confirm.
2. Both sides see it — The pact appears in both Slack inboxes. No one can claim they forgot.
3. Automatic reminders — Pact sends reminders every 30 minutes in the 24-hour window before and after the due date. A daily digest at 9am ET also surfaces all open pacts each morning.
4. `/done` — Mark the commitment complete. Both sides see the resolution.

You can also message Pact directly in a DM using natural language:
- "I need to send the report to @alice by Thursday"
- "my pacts" — lists your active commitments
- "done" — marks your most recent pact complete

## Commands

- `/pact @person [description] by [date]` — Create a two-person pact
- `/pact [description] by [date]` — Create a solo pact (personal accountability)
- `/pacts` — List your active pacts
- `/done` — Mark the most recent pact complete

## Pricing

- **Free** — $0/month, forever. 30 active pacts/month, /pact and /done slash commands, DM conversational interface, automatic reminders, daily digest. No credit card required.
- **Team** — Coming soon. $5/seat/month (min 3 seats). Team dashboard, trust scores.
- **Pro** — Coming soon. $10/seat/month (min 3 seats). Unlimited pacts, advanced analytics.

## Installation

1. Visit https://makepact.co
2. Click "Add to Slack"
3. Authorize the OAuth permissions
4. Slack redirects you into a DM with Pact — you're live in under 2 minutes

No credit card required for the Free plan.

## Slack Permissions Required

- `commands` — respond to /pact, /pacts, /done
- `chat:write` — send reminders and confirmations
- `im:write` — send DMs
- `users:read` — resolve @mentions to teammates

Pact does NOT read your channel messages or workspace data.

- Product type: Slack bot / SaaS

- Ideal users: Teams who use Slack and struggle with commitments slipping through the cracks — engineering teams, ops, product, any team that makes promises and needs to keep them
- Core differentiator: Bilateral visibility. Unlike to-do apps or calendar reminders, Pact makes BOTH PARTIES accountable — not just the person who created the task.

## FAQ

**Q: Does Pact work for solo commitments?**
A: Yes. `/pact [description] by [date]` without an @mention creates a solo pact tracked only for you.

**Q: Is Pact free?**
A: The Free plan is permanently free and covers up to 30 active pacts/month for teams of 2.

**Q: Can Pact integrate with project management tools?**
A: Linear, Jira, and GitHub integrations are on the roadmap for the Pro plan. Currently, Pact works natively within Slack — no external integrations required.

**Q: Does Pact send a daily digest?**
A: Yes. Every morning at 9am ET, Pact sends a digest in Slack listing all your open pacts — organized by made, assigned to you, and overdue. Automatic reminders also fire every 30 minutes in the 24-hour window around each pact's due date.

**Q: Does Pact read my Slack messages?**
A: No. Pact only receives slash command invocations and direct messages sent to the Pact bot. It does not access channel history.
